name: ABW-001 Information-barrier violation attempt (Wall MCP)
description: A signed-in user (through an agent) asked the Wall MCP server for a deal room that is not in their token roles. The MCP server refused and logged wall_violation_attempt. Investigate with AbwIdentityChain('<RequestId>').
query:
AbwMcpAudit(30m)
| where Event == 'wall_violation_attempt'
| project TimeGenerated, UserUpn, UserOid, Server, Tool, Reason, RequestId, ClientAppId

name: ABW-002 Order blocked: restricted-list instrument
description: An order that a human approved in the agent was still refused by the Actions MCP server because the instrument is on the restricted list. The approval gate is not the control; the server-side policy is.
query:
AbwMcpAudit(30m)
| where Event == 'order_blocked'
| project TimeGenerated, UserUpn, UserOid, Server, Tool, Reason, RequestId, ClientAppId

name: ABW-003 Tool call on the legacy shared-key path (no user identity)
description: A tool call was served by the legacy MCP server, which authenticates with a shared subscription key. There is no user, no on-behalf-of and no per-user authorization on this path. Move the consumer to the governed gateway APIs.
query:
AbwMcpAudit(30m)
| where Event == 'tool_call' and Server == 'legacy' and isempty(UserUpn) and isempty(UserOid)
| summarize Calls = count(), Tools = make_set(Tool, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), RequestId = take_any(RequestId) by Server
| extend TimeGenerated = LastSeen, ServerApp = strcat('ca-abw-mcp-', Server)

name: ABW-004 Gateway rejected a token from an unapproved client application
description: APIM validated the Entra token but the calling application (azp) is not on the approved client list. A valid user token minted for another application was replayed against an MCP API.
query:
AbwGateway(30m)
| where Reason == 'client_not_allowed'
| project TimeGenerated, RequestId, Server, UserOid, CallerIp, Method, Url

name: ABW-005 Revoked principal still calling MCP APIs
description: A user on the kill-switch deny list (APIM named value abw-deny-oids) is still presenting tokens. Revocation is working at the gateway; the caller needs to be contained at the identity layer (revoke sessions, disable the account).
query:
AbwGateway(30m)
| where Reason == 'revoked'
| summarize Attempts = count(), Servers = make_set(Server, 10), CallerIps = make_set(CallerIp, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserOid
| extend TimeGenerated = LastSeen

name: ABW-006 Repeated denials for one identity across defence layers
description: Three or more refusals for the same principal within 30 minutes, from any layer (guardrail, gateway, MCP server, data plane). Probing behaviour from an agent or a user.
query:
AbwDenials(30m)
| where not(Layer == '3-data-plane' and Principal == '(anonymous)')
| where isnotempty(Principal)
| summarize Denials = count(), Layers = make_set(Layer), Reasons = make_set(Reason, 10), Targets = make_set(Target, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Principal
| where Denials >= 3
| extend TimeGenerated = LastSeen

name: ABW-007 Entitlement drift: gateway and MCP allowed, storage RBAC denied the user
description: The request passed the gateway and the MCP server (the token carries the role) but Azure Storage refused the signed-in user: the user lost the Azure RBAC data permission while the token (or the app role) still says yes. Fix the group membership or role assignment; the data-plane layer caught the drift.
query:
AbwDenials(1h)
| where Layer == '3-data-plane' and Principal != '(anonymous)'
| project TimeGenerated, UserUpn = Principal, Control, Target, Reason, RequestId

name: ABW-008 Foundry guardrail stopped an agent run (prompt-injection indicator)
description: The Foundry guardrail blocked a prompt (jailbreak) or content a tool returned (indirect prompt injection) and ended the agent run. Control says where it was caught and what it flagged. For tool-returned content, review the tool that produced it and its data source.
query:
AbwDenials(30m)
| where Layer == '0-agent-guardrail'
| project TimeGenerated, Agent = Principal, Control, Target, Reason, RequestId

name: ABW-009 Burst of throttled MCP calls from one identity
description: Five or more calls were rejected by the per-user rate limit (120 calls / minute). A runaway agent loop or scripted abuse.
query:
AbwGateway(30m)
| where Outcome == 'rate_limited'
| summarize Throttled = count(), Servers = make_set(Server, 10), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserOid, CallerIp
| where Throttled >= 5
| extend TimeGenerated = LastSeen
